summary: Triple Flag Precious Metals Corp. filed a Form 6-K reporting a settlement agreement with Steppe Gold Ltd. The settlement resolves arrears under a stream and prepay agreement, with immediate delivery of 4,096 gold ounces and 15,618 silver ounces, plus fixed quarterly gold deliveries totaling 34,770 ounces over ten years starting Q3 2026, with no ongoing payments. Post-2036, Triple Flag receives 1.5% of quarterly ATO mine production capped at 500 ounces. This is a contractual amendment, not a change-of-control or special situation like an acquisition or restructuring. The filing updates guidance and partnership terms, not a corporate event triggering special-situation classification.
